title: CREPE Preprocess
text: Preprocess audio for CREPE deep pitch estimation, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Sample rate of input signal (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input signal, {Overlap percentage (%)} sets the overlap percentage between consecutive and {Number of output frames} sets the number of generated frames. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Sample rate of input signal (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of input signal in Hz 16e3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Number of output frames
params.values: Number of generated frames 1 (default) | positive integer
